answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond that vests slowly, like water filtering from a wide ocean through a narrow lagoon: one identity is cheap, but spinning up thousands locks capital for months and earns nothing until verified work is done. A reputation prism then splits each history into observable facets - completed tasks, peer endorsements, dispute outcomes - so a fresh clone cannot inherit trust. An attacker must fund every fake identity and wait out vesting, while honest agents compound reputation, making a large sybil farm cost more than it could capture.
